title: Know your people.
subtitle: DonorDock gives you a complete picture of every supporter — then uses AI to surface the right next steps so you don't have to hold it all in your head.

cards.title: Contact Profiles & Segmentation
cards.body: One complete record per contact: giving history, event attendance, email engagement, notes, and custom badges. Segment and report on any combination.
items: Badge contacts: camper, supporter, gala attendee, major donor
Track giving: lifetime, year-to-date, first, largest, last gift
Email opens and text replies visible on the contact record
Take action on any segment directly from a report

cards.title: Otto AI — Your Smart Steward
cards.body: Otto monitors your donor activity and surfaces the things you'd want to know but would likely miss on a busy day.
items: Smart Nudges: "This key donor hasn't heard from you in 45 days"
Gift spike alerts: unusual changes warrant a personal follow-up
Lapsing donor flags before they fully disengage
Birthdays, anniversaries, and milestone gifts surfaced automatically
Instant profile summaries — no reading through notes

cards.title: Grant, Major Gift & Sponsor Pipelines
cards.body: Kanban pipelines for every cultivation track — see status, next move, and projected totals at a glance.
items: Lily Foundation and other grants: applied, pending, awarded
Major gifts: identified, qualifying, cultivating, soliciting
Roll-up totals: pipeline value, weighted, open asks

cards.title: Automations
cards.body: Build once, run always. Three types keep your team focused on relationships, not logistics.

mini_cards.label: Internal
mini_cards.body: Task assignments, staff alerts on key gifts

mini_cards.label: Data
mini_cards.body: Auto-tag donors, update records on activity
